title: Towards Copyright Protection for Knowledge Bases of Retrieval-augmented Language Models via Reasoning
authors: Junfeng Guo; Yiming Li; Ruibo Chen; Yihan Wu; Chenxi Liu; Yanshuo Chen; Heng Huang
why_relevant: Proposes watermarking for copyright protection of RAG knowledge bases via CoT, tangentially related to RAG security but focused on IP protection rather than robustness against unreliable evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Not about robustness, conflict, calibration, or defending against adversarial retrieval; uses backdoor-like techniques for ownership verification.
